lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A Deck App for **Host Control**. It lists the computers linked in the VitaDeck Shell with each one's live CPU load, and for the selected one shows its capabilities, CPU and memory gauges from the [`system-stats`](../../host-plugins/system-stats) plugin, and an Echo round trip.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. On the computer: `pnpm --dir js host-companion start` (see the [Host Companion README](../../packages/host-companion/README.md)).

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 2. On VitaDeck: press Start, open Host Control, and note the link address.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 3. On the computer: `pnpm --dir js host-companion link <link address>`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Link more computers the same way; each gets its own row. D-pad and Cross pick one.
